mapper.select: SELECT POST_ID AS postId , USER_ID AS userId , ( SELECT u.USER_NAME FROM users u WHERE cp.USER_ID = u.USER_ID ) AS userName , CATEGORY AS category , ( SELECT cc1.CATEGORY_NAME FROM community_category cc1 WHERE cp.CATEGORY = cc1.CATEGORY_CODE ) AS categoryName , TITLE AS title , CONTENT AS content , VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount , CREATE_DT AS createDt , UPDATE_DT AS updateDt , ( SELECT COUNT(cc.COMMENT_ID) FROM community_comment cc WHERE cc.POST_ID = cp.POST_ID AND cc.DELETE_YN = 'N' ) AS commentCnt , ( SELECT u.USER_ROLE FROM users u WHERE cp.USER_ID = u.USER_ID ) AS userRole FROM community_post cp WHERE cp.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY cp.CREATE_DT desc

SELECT CATEGORY_CODE as categoryCode , CATEGORY_NAME as categoryName , DESCRIPTION as description , SORT_ORDER as SORT_ORDER , USE_YN as useYn , CREATE_DT AS createDt , UPDATE_DT AS updateDt FROM community_category WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY sort_order

SELECT cc.COMMENT_ID AS commentId , cc.POST_ID AS postId , cc.USER_ID AS userId , (SELECT u.USER_NAME FROM users u WHERE u.USER_ID = cc.USER_ID) AS userName , cc.PARENT_ID AS parentId , (SELECT u.USER_ROLE FROM users u WHERE u.USER_ID = cc.USER_ID) AS userRole , cc.depth AS depth , CASE WHEN cc.DELETE_YN = 'Y' THEN '삭제된 댓글입니다.' ELSE cc.CONTENT END AS content , cc.CREATE_DT AS createDt , cc.UPDATE_DT AS updateDt , cc.DELETE_YN AS deleteYn FROM community_comment cc JOIN community_post cp ON cc.POST_ID = cp.POST_ID WHERE cc.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY cc.CREATE_DT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO community_comment ( POST_ID , USER_ID , PARENT_ID , DEPTH , CONTENT , CREATE_DT ) SELECT parent.POST_ID , #{userId} , parent.COMMENT_ID , parent.DEPTH + 1 , #{content} , NOW() FROM community_comment parent WHERE parent.COMMENT_ID = #{parentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_post SET DELETE_YN = 'Y', DELETE_DT = NOW() WHERE POST_ID = #{postId}
UPDATE community_comment SET DELETE_YN = 'Y', DELETE_DT = NOW() WHERE COMMENT_ID = #{commentId} AND DELETE_YN = 'N'
